solution_summary: Fujitsu Ltd., a Microsoft-focused organization in Japan, modernized this data lake / data warehouse modernization workload with Azure, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Power BI. Having supported the accounting operations of Japanese companies for nearly 50 years, "GLOVIA" has strengthened its collaboration with Azure, completed verification, and is already being adopted with Azure by multiple companies. Azure provides the scalable cloud foundation hosting the customer’s modernized applications, data, and AI workloads. Azure Databricks processes, engineers, and analyzes data workloads on scalable Spark infrastructure. Azure Synapse Analytics unifies analytical processing, data engineering, and reporting workloads on a shared platform. Data from operational systems is ingested into Azure, processed across Azure Databricks, and surfaced through Azure Synapse Analytics so teams can act on fresher operational insight.

Fujitsu's ERP, GLOVIA, Now Migratable to Azure or Newly Introduced on Azure. Connects to Cloud Services, Aims to Resolve 2025 Digital Cliff

Having supported the accounting operations of Japanese companies for nearly 50 years, ”GLOVIA” has strengthened its collaboration with Azure, completed verification, and is already being adopted with Azure by multiple companies. “

“The need for the cloud is increasing more and more, and what we are paying particular attention is the need for Azure. Customers who select Azure as their company-wide system platform often tell us that they want to use GLOVIA SUMMIT within the same system environment. For example, on shipbuilding company took the opportunity of updating the hardware of its on-premises virtual platform that had been operating GLOVIA and the end of support for Windows Servers to decide to migrate to Azure, which offered Extended Security Updates for free and the benefit of bringing its own licenses. They say that there were some parts where the load distribution function of the add-on part could not be solved with a single service, but in the future, they will be able to consider Azure data services for applications, data linkage, and data utilization associated with the migration of core systems to the cloud. There is also a case of a major retail company. They are migrating not only GLOVIA SUMMIT but also its merchandising system to Azure. I believe that by using the data platform system, Azure Databricks, they will be able to achieve closer integration.” (Mr. Ogane)

“While our customers’ operations are diverse, accounting-related operations are becoming increasingly computerized due to the Electronic Books Maintenance Act, the invoice system, etc. Against such background, there is a need to connect various operations using the cloud. Information analysis based on data collected by linking with many systems can now be provided in the cloud, enabling smooth operations for our customers. We also have high expectations for data analysis using Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Power BI, etc.” (Mr. Sato)
